annotations.title: Get a company's details and deadlines

description: One of the signed-in customer's companies: its details, what needs them (needs_you, each with the create_company_link purpose that opens it), and its compliance deadlines: attention (overdue, waiting on them, or due soon) and upcoming. owner says whose job each deadline is: "cosec" (the firm), "you" (the customer), or another adviser such as "tax_agent" or "auditor". explain_deadline explains one by its deadline_key.
